status: Frozen after complete exploratory time pilot and before confirmation calculations
comparison_rule: Time-side eligibility is evaluated without equilibrium. Numerical agreement requires time-side checks, stable equilibrium fits, <=5% relative endpoint difference and overlapping model/window sensitivity ranges; ranges are not confidence intervals. This is finite-window evidence, not an equality theorem.
selection_method: Exploratory coverage and boundary-overlap diagnostics, without selecting for equilibrium agreement. Existing dense large-size baselines plus cross-class new checks and two difficult class-2 controls; not an exhaustive automatic ranking.

selection_reasons.uniform_A: Analytic and literature benchmark; fill missing half-step points.
selection_reasons.one_B_2: Existing multi-size benchmark; test broader window and late shifts.
selection_reasons.diagonal_B_3: Existing multi-size data; retain imperfect model stability as a test.
selection_reasons.random_half_3: Existing multi-size mixed-class data; retain smaller overlap as a test.
selection_reasons.one_B_3: Strong regular boundary overlap; existing time coverage stops at L108.
selection_reasons.special_matched_a: Regular boundary overlap and relatively flat raw slopes; missing large sizes.
selection_reasons.general_matched_a: Mixed class with regular low-energy overlap and small same-time size differences.
selection_reasons.near02_irregular3: Mostly empty/double mixed example; raw slopes are smooth but narrow-model ambiguity remains.
selection_reasons.pure02_block4: Class-2 control with regular overlap but unresolved previous corrected fits.
selection_reasons.pure02_notched_stripe4: Class-2 control with small gapped overlap; raw size agreement alone was insufficient.

not_confirmed_interpretation: Pilot-only coverage is insufficient for a new confirmation label; do not call these patterns impossible or failed asymptotically.
